scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn inner_world.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.api:check: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api scripts/export_contracts.py && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api scripts/export_contracts.py && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/export_contracts.py && node scripts/generate_types.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run api:check && npm run format:check
